name: Meeting - Book Meeting Room

parameters.query: WITH cancel_deactivated AS (UPDATE {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.meeting_bookings SET status = 'CANCELLED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE NULLIF($1::text, '') IS NULL AND NULLIF($5::text, '') IS NOT NULL AND organizer_id = NULLIF($5::text, '')::uuid AND start_time > NOW() AND status = 'SCHEDULED' RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.meeting_rooms WHERE NULLIF($1::text, '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF($2::text, '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF($3::text, '') IS NOT NULL AND id = NULLIF($1::text, '')::uuid AND is_active = true AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.meeting_bookings b WHERE b.room_id = NULLIF($1::text, '')::uuid AND b.status != 'CANCELLED' AND ($4::text = '' OR b.id::text != $4::text) AND tstzrange(b.start_time, b.end_time) && tstzrange(NULLIF($2::text, '')::timestamptz, NULLIF($3::text, '')::timestamptz));

INSERT INTO {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.meeting_bookings (id, room_id, organizer_id, title, start_time, end_time, status, description) VALUES (COALESCE(NULLIF($7::text, '')::uuid, uuid_generate_v4()), NULLIF($1::text, '')::uuid, NULLIF($2::text, '')::uuid, COALESCE(NULLIF($3::text, ''), 'Cuộc họp'), NULLIF($4::text, '')::timestamptz, NULLIF($5::text, '')::timestamptz, 'SCHEDULED', $6) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = NOW() RETURNING id;
